thread:
Elena (PM): Quick sync — Q4 hosted API consolidation. We need to agree prioritization and concrete launch criteria for: embeddings batch API, rerank SLA, chat function-calling stability. What are must-haves vs nice-to-haves?
Marcus (Eng): Must-have: stable 95th p latency for chat <120ms for small contexts. Embeddings batch API: api shape + backpressure. Rerank SLA: 99.9% success + graceful fallback.
Priya (ML): Agree on metrics. For rerank we need NDCG@10 drop <0.02 vs current. If quantization affects quality we should ship a fallback float path.
Sam (SRE): Capacity note — embeddings batch will change traffic patterns. We need a canary plan + attestation for autoscaler configs. Propose canary: 10% traffic for 2h, 30% for 6h, then 100% if no regressions.
Jonah (PM): Several customers asked for synchronous batch embeddings endpoint and clearer pricing. If we don't ship batch sync, they'll ask for custom work. This is borderline "must-have" for adoption by analytics teams.
Elena (PM): Thanks. Quick proposed prioritization: 1) Rerank SLA + fallback 2) Chat function-call stability (esp. streaming) 3) Embeddings batch API (sync) as Q4 target but maybe soft-launch. Are we aligned?
Marcus (Eng): Mostly. For (1) we need an infra change: prefix KV caching bypass for rerank requests to avoid cache explosion. Risk: ~2d infra work + rollout test.
Priya (ML): Also need eval harness for rerank A/B tests. I can add a 50-query testset per customer to validate pre/post quality. Pass criteria: no more than 1% user-visible regression and NDCG drop <0.02.
Sam (SRE): Canary config suggestion (yaml snippet):
```
canary_policy:
  - pct: 10
    duration: 2h
  - pct: 30
    duration: 6h
  - pct: 100
    duration: 1h
fallback: rdl-v1-fallback
monitoring: [latency, error_rate, ndcg_estimate]
```
Marcus (Eng): +1 on snippet. Add automated rollback on error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m.
Elena (PM): Launch criteria checklist (draft):
- Perf: 95th p latency within target (chat/rerank/embeddings)
- Quality: NDCG/regression thresholds met per Priya
- Reliability: rollback and canary automation in place
- Observability: per-route dashboards, token-level cost, and traces
- Docs & pricing: quickstart + pricing blurb for embeddings batch
Priya (ML): For embeddings batch, add sampling checks for vector stability (cosine drift < 1e-3) across quantized models.
Jonah (PM): Commercial ask: offer a "batch embeddings pilot" SKU — keep pricing TBD but list as "pilot" in docs.
observability-bot: New dashboard created: /dashboards/hosted/q4-consolidation (owner: Observability Team) :white_check_mark:
Sam (SRE): Operational constraints: if embedding batch causes spike in token-per-second we throttle at 2x baseline to protect latency SLOs. Need feature flag for per-customer rate caps.
Marcus (Eng): Implementation notes: batching impl will add a configurable batch_size limit and a timeout param. Default: batch_size=512, max_wait=25ms. We'll expose via API options.
Elena (PM): Decision for roadmap doc: mark Rerank SLA + fallback as committed for Q4 GA, Chat function-calling stability as committed, Embeddings batch as beta/pilot with restricted rollout. Owners: Marcus (rerank + chat infra), Priya (quality + eval), Sam (canary + ops), Jonah (commercial pilot).
Jonah (PM): I'll draft pilot SKU and outreach list by Tue.
Priya (ML): I'll scaffold eval harness and initial testsets today.
Marcus (Eng): I'll open infra PR for cache-bypass + canary automation by EOD.
Elena (PM): Perfect — follow-ups: Marcus pls link PRs here, Sam add canary config to runbook, Jonah start pilot comms. :thumbsup:
Sam (SRE): noted.
Elena (PM): If no objections, I'll update the Q4 roadmap doc and OKR slice tonight. Otherwise flag now.
Jonah (PM): No objections from me.
Priya (ML): LGTM.
Marcus (Eng): LGTM.
